response.justification: Bogdan brings extensive Staff-level experience, demonstrated expertise in high-throughput distributed systems (handling millions of requests per second), and highly relevant, hands-on experience building AI-agent infrastructure and MCP code generators. While he completely lacks the required Python expertise, his deep mastery of TypeScript, systems architecture, and agentic workflows strongly aligns with the core mindset and technical demands of the role, making him a compelling candidate worth interviewing.
strengths: Direct hands-on experience building AI-agent infrastructure, MCP code generators, and agentic workflows.
Proven track record designing high-throughput distributed systems, including microservices handling millions of requests per second.
Strong Staff-level technical leadership with a focus on software craftsmanship, TDD, and operational ownership.
concerns: Complete lack of Python experience on the resume, which is explicitly listed as a must-have technical skill.
Heavy reliance on niche languages (e.g., Dlang) for low-latency backend systems instead of standard enterprise stacks.
Transitioning to a Python-heavy technical strategy role may require significant ramp-up time.
